en: Giant bamboo can grow up to 91 centimeters in a single day, making it the fastest-growing plant.
An octopus has three hearts and blue blood to pump oxygen efficiently through its body.
Human stomach acid is so strong that it can easily dissolve metal razor blades.
Periodical cicadas spend either 13 or 17 years underground as nymphs before emerging as winged adults.
Trees in a forest communicate and share nutrients through a massive underground network of fungal threads.
The wood frog survives freezing winter temperatures by letting its heart stop and its body freeze solid.
A fever is actually a healthy immune response that makes your body too hot for invading germs.
The dung beetle navigates by using the light of the Milky Way galaxy to roll its food.
The Venus flytrap counts touches on its trigger hairs to ensure it only traps live, moving prey.
A human baby is born with about 300 bones, which fuse together to form 206 adult bones.
Coral reefs cover less than one percent of the ocean floor but support twenty-five percent of marine species.
A hummingbird's heart beats up to 1,200 times per minute while it hovers in the air.
